text:
Zoe: POC with NovaHealth hit a 429 during a live walkthrough. They say portal shows ~7k trial credits but API returned quota_exceeded. Demo paused.

Kai: Can we get the exact error and any response headers?

Zoe: Customer pasted: > {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":429,"detail":"trial_credits_depleted"}
No headers in the screenshot.

Nina: Pulling billing ledger now. One sec.

ops-oncall: Checked edge logs for acct nova-health: some responses include:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 150
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 14
x-account-credits: 0
```
Primary cause is credits=0, rate-limit shows burst exhaustion.

billing-bot: Spend alert triggered for nova-health: current_usage $1,120, threshold $1,000 at 2026-03-12T16:43:21Z. Credits on file: 0.

Nina: Confirmed billing DB credits_remaining=0. Portal cache shows old balance due to yesterday's migration job failing to invalidate.

Zoe: Customer needs a quick top-up for remainder of demo. Can we do that?

SE-Alex: We should also give them a short explainer about how streaming token usage maps to credits so they don't get surprised afterwards.

Nina: I can grant a one-off 8000 credits for the POC env after finance sign-off.

ops-oncall: I'll temporarily raise soft rate-limit for nova-health 150->600 for 3 hours to reduce demo flakiness.

billing-bot: Finance approval required for one-off credit > $500. Approver: @Nina or @Sam-Finance.

Zoe: Sam-Finance is reachable via DM, will ping.

Nina: Approved by Sam-Finance via DM. Executing grant and invalidating portal cache now.

billing-bot: Manual credit grant recorded: +8000 credits by Nina at 2026-03-12T16:46:03Z.

ops-oncall: Cache invalidated for acct nova-health. Portal now reports 8000 credits. Rate-limit bumped.

Zoe: Re-ran customer's curl and streaming works, header shows x-account-credits: 7996. Demo resumed.

SE-Alex: I'll send a short customer note: (1) root cause (migration cache mismatch + credit exhaustion), (2) what we did (top-up, mute alerts, raised rate-limit temporarily), (3) offer a follow-up to walk token burn rates.

Nina: Filing infra ticket INF-2026-399 to add migration cache invalidation test and a portal/billing delta alert when difference > 500 credits. Also BILL-2026-090 to reconcile one-off credits.

Zoe: Thanks team. Please keep me posted if anything re-appears. :thumbsup:
